question: After the active-surface failure is repaired, should the fail-closed validation-command grammar, explicit non-live proof-subsumption mechanism, and strict server-side base-binding requirement become the permanent repair merge boundary?
rationale: These choices intentionally define which cross-repository commands may execute or be skipped and which branch-protection guarantees are mandatory before an automated merge.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge after the narrow fixture repair and a green full check, requiring focused coverage for every future command form or proof-subsumption contract.

options.title: Disable subsumption initially
options.body: Land staged ordering, proof identity, and strict base binding while leaving configured proof subsumption unused until separately approved.

options.title: Split the boundaries
options.body: Review command parsing, proof subsumption, and strict merge authorization as narrower independent changes.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Merge after the narrow fixture repair and a green full check, requiring focused coverage for every future command form or proof-subsumption contract.
